title: Free-TPKC attack

target.description: 7-round AES-192 with initial whitening and no final MixColumns; two distinct keys yield the same complete ciphertext for one shared attacker-chosen plaintext.

setting.key_relation: Two distinct attacker-chosen master keys; no secret related-key oracle.
setting.plaintext_model: One shared plaintext chosen together with the collision pair.
assumptions: SAT characteristic search cost is not included in the reported attack work.
Work is expected collision-generation cost; component trail probabilities are not end-to-end success.

time.note: Author expected-work estimate; no fixed-budget collision probability provided.

data.note: Offline public-cipher construction; no secret-key oracle data budget.

memory.note: Table1 has a dash, not a numerical storage bound.

success.description: The checked analysis gives an expected-work or filtering argument without a numeric probability for the complete named output event.

evidence.interpretation: Defining primary-text costs, output event and conditions checked together.

limitations: The complete named output probability is not quantified by the source.
